sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Colors Run Ball are simple yet challenging. The game takes place on a grid, where a circle will be moving from left to right. Your goal is to touch the squares to change the color of the circle to match the color of the ball. If you succeed, you will score points and continue playing. However, if the circle is not the same color as the ball, the game will be over. This simple yet challenging gameplay mechanic makes Colors Run Ball a game that requires focus and strategy.
